lii.name: Kenya Law
lii.blocked: Kenya Law's terms of use (https://kenyalaw.org/terms-of-use/, s. 9) prohibit automated data scraping, bulk extraction and commercial redistribution without an explicit Licensing Agreement from NCLR; only raw, unannotated source documents are CC BY-NC 4.0, and the consolidated point-in-time Acts are NCLR's revised work. Nothing is fetched until the user has a licence or decides otherwise (contact: info@kenyalaw.org). Remove this key to enable fetch.py.

publisher.name: Kenya Law (National Council for Law Reporting)

default_in_force_rule.text: Not applied: every version is dated by Kenya Law's own expression date, the day the amendment it incorporates took effect as Laws.Africa records it. No date is computed from a default rule.

country.licence_note: To be set from the licence agreement with NCLR.

decisions: Acts proposed for Phase 1, not yet checked against the archive: the Constitution of Kenya 2010 (few amendments), the Penal Code (Cap. 63) and the Data Protection Act 2019. The Wayback CDX index (one request, 2026-10-28) holds 2,941 Kenyan act works under new.kenyalaw.org with up to 38 archived expressions each, so Kenya's history is well archived once a licence allows its use.
